The '''Ando system''' was a three-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].
